what: The 1 m slope measure applied to the path Perseverance drove inside the mission area

source.title: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation HiRISE DTM mosaic, 1 m

method: Elevation posts 1 m apart are read under the route. Every 1 m along it, a plane is fitted to the 5 x 5 posts around that point (4 m across, about the footprint of a rover). Slope is the tilt of that plane; roughness is the RMS height of the posts about it. A stretch is reported when the slope stays above the mover's limit for 2 m or more.
limits: A 1 m elevation model made from orbital stereo images resolves shapes a few metres across. It does not show individual rocks, loose sand or ripples.
note: NASA publishes the path as points about 1 m apart. The path and the orbital elevation model can be a few metres out of register, so the steepest values on the path are an upper bound on what the rover crossed.
